text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer believes that racing in the Twinkle Series shouldn't be all about pressure. She thinks she should place more emphasis on having fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to run in freestyle races again, where she doesn't have to worry about constraints or responsibilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she finds that running off-grid isn't satisfying enough. They're still heated and fun, but there isn't enough pressure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to go back to competing against Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen. She wants the pride that comes from beating them in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having realized where she belongs, Mejiro Palmer returns to the Twinkle Series.
